pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal geometries with moderately smooth edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are larger and more elongated, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the primary flank area but narrows as patches become more densely packed near the rump.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck, consisting of dense, vertical hair filaments against the background.
